freeze.rule: No V2 candidate change after this point; First 10 holdout is measured and scored only against this exact file (sha256 recorded in calibration_corpus_v1.json).

rules.A_lo: median over the FLOW_SIZE family of primary A_raw
rules.A_hi: maximum over the whole calibration corpus of primary A_raw
rules.U_p95_hi: maximum over the corpus of p95 unlock wave
rules.U_mean_hi: maximum over the corpus of mean unlock wave
rules.R_len_lo: median over the FLOW_SIZE family of primary mean route length / diagonal
rules.R_len_hi: maximum over the corpus of primary mean route length / diagonal
rules.R_detour_lo: median over the FLOW_SIZE family of primary mean detour
rules.R_detour_hi: maximum over the corpus of primary mean detour
rules.R_turn_lo: median over the FLOW_SIZE family of primary mean turns
rules.R_turn_hi: maximum over the corpus of primary mean turns
rules.reason: FLOW_SIZE is the declared minimum-structure family (every colour touches the border, balanced supply); the corpus maximum is the declared structural extreme. Linear clamp keeps the locked weights meaningful on [0,1]. The First 10 are never read by the calibration step.

ordinalPairs.why: same 6 colours, balanced vs one dominant
same colours/cell counts, both border-touching (unlock wave 0): eight 1-wide shafts expose ~8 targets at a time vs a solid band exposing a whole edge
six alternating rings vs one outer band
serpentine single-entrance corridor vs open block
same board; outer layer only in column 1, inner layers only in columns 2-3
same board; 30-robot batches straddle rings and wait vs ring-aligned batches
a compact 20x20 fortress/bottleneck is harder than a 48x48 flow board (size does not dictate class)
identical 12 two-wide stripes; 6 vs 3 balanced colours
identical 12 two-wide stripes; 12 vs 6 balanced colours
identical 12 two-wide stripes, 6 colours; balanced vs one colour on half the stripes
